name: tuya-ac
description: Web app and smart heating for the Electriq Easy-fit air conditioner (Tuya / Smart Life), on Cloudflare's free plan

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:mine: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.mine.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.mine.jsonc

TUYA_CLIENT_ID.description: **Access ID** of your cloud project at [platform.tuya.com](https://platform.tuya.com) › Cloud › Development › your project › Overview.

TUYA_DEVICE_ID.description: Your air conditioner's **Device ID**: your project › Devices › All Devices (after linking your Smart Life app).

APP_PASSWORD.description: The password you'll type to open the app. Use a long one: the app is on a public address.

TUYA_BASE.description: Your Tuya data centre. Leave as is for Central Europe; Western America `https://openapi.tuyaus.com`, China `https://openapi.tuyacn.com`, India `https://openapi.tuyain.com`.

DB.description: Stores your settings, rules and readings. Created for you.
